# SimpleOne

> SimpleOne is an enterprise low-code and GenAI platform for intelligent business process automation across IT service management, HR, asset management, and CRM.

SimpleOne provides a comprehensive ecosystem of automation solutions including ITSM, ITAM, HRMS, ESM, and B2B CRM, with GenAI capabilities and a marketplace for integrations. The platform serves enterprises globally, with recent expansion into Saudi Arabia and strong presence in Russia.

## Key Topics

- Low-code platform
- GenAI automation
- Business process automation
- ITSM (IT Service Management)
- ITAM (IT Asset Management)
- HRMS (Human Resource Management)
- ESM (Enterprise Service Management)
- B2B CRM
- SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle)
- Digital transformation
- ITIL compliance
- CMDB (Configuration Management Database)
- Enterprise solutions
- Marketplace integrations
- Service management

## Core Platforms

- [SimpleOne - enterprise low-code and GenAI platform for business process automation](https://simpleone.io): SimpleOne ecosystem for low-code automation and GenAI-powered business processes
- [Low-code platform - accelerating digital transformation](https://simpleone.io/low-code): SimpleOne low-code platform for fast automation and customization of business processes
- [GenAI platform for intelligent automation of business processes](https://simpleone.io/genai-platform): GenAI platform for intelligent workflow automation with ChatGPT and Claude integration

## Service Management Solutions

- [ITSM - IT service management system](https://simpleone.io/itsm): ITSM solution for IT service management aligned with ITIL practices and standards
- [ESM system for business process automation](https://simpleone.io/esm): ESM system for automating business and IT department processes with operational efficiency
- [ITAM - management and work with IT assets of the company](https://simpleone.io/itam): ITAM system for managing IT assets and lifecycle according to ISO 19770-1

## Business Applications

- [HRMS - HR management automation system](https://simpleone.io/hrms): HRMS for comprehensive HR automation with no-code/low-code customization capabilities
- [B2B CRM - system for corporate sales and marketing](https://simpleone.io/b2b-crm): B2B CRM system for automating corporate sales and marketing in B2B segment
- [Software development management system - SDLC](https://simpleone.io/sdlc): SDLC management system with Agile, Scrum, Kanban methodologies and version control
